note: Two reusable rule candidates emerged from the review findings; no fallow or complaint signal was present.

candidates.text: Placeholder text in constrained inputs should fit the narrowest supported viewport without clipping.
candidates.rationale: The profile page's half-width Name input truncated a conversational placeholder ('What should Rahat call y') on the 520px card, forcing a post-review shortening. Checking placeholder length against the actual constrained input width prevents this class of visual regression.

candidates.text: Page-level tests should cover both empty-state and pre-filled-state render paths when the page can load existing data from an API.
candidates.rationale: The profile page's initial test suite only exercised the empty-state save path. A separate render path loads `state.user` into the form, and that path was untested until the review follow-up. Covering both states catches binding regressions for loaded data.
